env.name: IVN_LIBRARY_APP
env.about: Your app's id in the App library, in lower case with underscores: for the prefix ACME GOR, acme_gor. Each retailer that installs your app connects with a key that names this id.
env.purpose: Your app's id in the App library, like acme_gor for the prefix ACME GOR

env.name: GOR_PREFIX
env.about: The prefix your app's names in the retailer's iVendNext start with, in capitals: the --prefix you gave start.py (for example ACME GOR).
env.purpose: Filled in for you: the prefix your app's names start with, like ACME GOR

env.name: GOR_PAGE_URL
env.about: Where guests reach this service's page: your hosted address (https://guest-ordering.example.app). Each code's link points there.
env.purpose: Your service's web address, where guests open the ordering page
